scenes.scene: A wide four-lane city road with a painted median, shops set back behind a footpath, light mixed traffic of cars, scooters and auto-rickshaws.

Ahead on the left, a plain white city bus without any markings slows and stops at a roofed bus shelter. The scooter keeps its lane, a little to the right of the bus.

As the scooter draws level with the rear of the stopped bus, a pair of feet becomes visible under the front of the bus. A young man in a grey shirt then steps out from in front of the bus towards the road, looking the other way.
The scooter eases off and slows well before him. The man notices, steps back to the bus's edge and waits; the scooter passes slowly and the road ahead is clear.

cue.en: Feet visible under the front of the stopped bus
cue.hi: रुकी बस के आगे के हिस्से के नीचे पैर दिख रहे हैं
